sections.title: Amazon Robotics and Fulfillment Automation
sections.description: For Amazon Robotics and Amazon's fulfillment center operations.

blocks.heading: Warehouse robot perception and manipulation
paragraphs: CV for the Amazon Robotics systems deployed in 750,000+ fulfillment locations globally — 3D object recognition for mixed-product bin-picking by Sparrow (product-level) and Robin/Cardinal (package-level) sorting robots, enabling the flexible manipulation capability that Amazon's high-SKU, high-variability product environment requires.

blocks.heading: Fulfillment center inventory anomaly detection
paragraphs: CV for the automated inventory monitoring systems in Amazon's fulfillment centers — detecting misrouted products, unauthorized items, and inventory discrepancies from the fixed camera and mobile robot imaging that Amazon's fulfillment centers generate at massive scale.

blocks.heading: Just Walk Out / Amazon Go retail CV
paragraphs: CV for the computer vision-based checkout-free retail technology that Amazon has deployed at Amazon Go and Amazon Fresh stores — multi-person tracking, product recognition, and shopping behavior interpretation for the cashierless retail applications that Amazon has commercialized.

sections.title: Boeing Aerospace Inspection CV
sections.description: For Boeing Commercial Airplanes (Renton and Everett WA) and the Puget Sound aerospace supply chain.

blocks.heading: Commercial aircraft fuselage and structure inspection
paragraphs: CV for automated inspection of Boeing's large commercial aircraft structures — detecting surface defects, fastener installation anomalies, and coating quality issues in the aluminum and carbon fiber composite structures of 737 and 787 fuselages with the accuracy that FAA quality system requirements demand.

blocks.heading: Composite material manufacturing inspection
paragraphs: CV for the carbon fiber composite manufacturing processes at Boeing's Everett facility — detecting porosity, delamination, and fiber orientation defects in the composite structures of the 787 Dreamliner's largely composite airframe.

blocks.heading: Aircraft component supplier quality inspection
paragraphs: CV for the quality inspection programs at Boeing's Tier 1 aerospace suppliers — Spirit AeroSystems, Hexcel, and other major suppliers using CV to meet Boeing's exacting first-article and production quality requirements.

sections.title: Microsoft Spatial Computing and Vision
sections.description: Microsoft (Redmond WA HQ) — HoloLens, Azure Computer Vision, and spatial computing.

blocks.heading: Mixed reality spatial understanding
paragraphs: CV for the spatial computing applications built on Microsoft's HoloLens platform — real-time scene reconstruction, object recognition for AR overlays, and the hand-tracking and eye-tracking CV for the HoloLens interface that Microsoft's enterprise mixed reality customers use for industrial training and remote assistance.

blocks.heading: Azure AI Vision integration
paragraphs: CV applications integrating with Microsoft's Azure Computer Vision services for the enterprise clients deploying vision AI through Microsoft's cloud infrastructure.

sections.title: Retail and Food Service CV (Starbucks)
sections.description: Starbucks (Seattle HQ) — the world's largest specialty coffee retailer with 35,000+ locations.

blocks.heading: Store operations and beverage quality CV
paragraphs: CV for Starbucks store operations monitoring — detecting equipment cleanliness, product placement compliance, and the operational quality standards that Starbucks maintains across its enormous global store network.

blocks.heading: Supply chain visual inspection for coffee and food
paragraphs: CV for the visual quality inspection of coffee beans, food products, and packaging at Starbucks's production and distribution facilities.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for all Boeing CV
